title: About Me
paragraphs: I’m a First Class Computer Science graduate who enjoys turning ideas and early experiments into practical, reliable software. My work spans applied AI, cross-platform mobile applications, and full-stack web systems, with a focus on intuitive user experiences, clean implementation, and building solutions that solve real-world problems.
facts: I enjoy turning rough product ideas into usable software.
I like working across the full stack, from UI to backend logic.
I am especially interested in AI-powered everyday tools.
